blocks.title: Legal notice
blocks.subline: The sections below are an outline. Replace each with your details; empty a section that does not apply (title and paragraphs) — it is then not shown.

blocks.title: Contact address
paras: Replace with your details: company name, street and number, postcode and town, country, email address.

blocks.title: Authorised representatives
paras: Replace with your details: first and last name of the people who represent the company, with their role.

blocks.title: Commercial register entry
paras: Replace with your details: registered company name, commercial register office, company identification number (UID).

blocks.title: VAT number
paras: Replace with your details: VAT number — or empty the section if it does not apply.

blocks.title: Disclaimer
paras: Replace with your details: your disclaimer for the content of this website.

blocks.title: Liability for links
paras: Replace with your details: your note on responsibility for linked third-party websites.

blocks.title: Copyright
paras: Replace with your details: who holds the rights to the texts, images and files of this website.
